overview.text: Soil_1_33 is a nonribosomal peptide cluster identified by DeepBGC and GECCO.
It spans 16 kb on contig_1 and contains 13 genes.

genes.text: The locus holds one regulatory, one transport, three tailoring-enzyme and one resistance gene according to BGC-XPLORER annotation categories.
Two core genes are named in the locus, each by at least one of DeepBGC and GECCO.
CJLEIP_04117 is annotated as a (pseudo) non-ribosomal peptide synthetase and named as a core gene by DeepBGC and GECCO.
CJLEIP_04116 is annotated as a thioester reductase domain-containing protein and named as a core gene by GECCO.

Additional genes include a glycosyl transferase, an RNA polymerase sigma factor, an extensin, an aspartyl/asparaginyl beta-hydroxylase domain-containing protein, two ATP-grasp domain-containing proteins, an SDR family oxidoreductase, a 2OG-Fe(II) oxygenase, a GNAT family N-acetyltransferase, an MFS transporter and a 3-hydroxyisobutyrate dehydrogenase.

similar.text: This locus has not been compared with MIBiG because antiSMASH did not detect it.

hypothesis.text: The cluster may produce a nonribosomal peptide that is glycosylated and further modified by oxidation and acetylation, given the presence of a glycosyl transferase, an SDR oxidoreductase, a 2OG-Fe(II) oxygenase and a GNAT N-acetyltransferase alongside the NRPS and thioester reductase core genes.

facts.sentence: Soil_1_33 is a nonribosomal peptide cluster, found by DeepBGC and GECCO.
It spans 16 kb on contig_1 (4,640,389–4,656,342) and contains 13 genes.
By the annotation categories of BGC-XPLORER, it holds 1 regulatory, 1 transport, 3 tailoring-enzyme and 1 resistance genes.
2 core genes are named in the locus, each by at least one of DeepBGC and GECCO.
CJLEIP_04117, annotated by Bakta as (pseudo) non-ribosomal peptide synthetase, is named as a core gene by DeepBGC and GECCO.
CJLEIP_04116, annotated by Bakta as thioester reductase domain-containing protein, is named as a core gene by GECCO.

Gene products in the locus, in genome order: CJLEIP_04109 Glycosyl transferase; CJLEIP_04110 RNA polymerase sigma factor; CJLEIP_04111 Extensin; CJLEIP_04112 Aspartyl/asparaginyl beta-hydroxylase domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_04113 ATP-grasp domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_04114 ATP-grasp domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_04115 SDR family oxidoreductase; CJLEIP_04116 thioester reductase domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_04117 (pseudo) non-ribosomal peptide synthetase; CJLEIP_04118 2OG-Fe(II) oxygenase; CJLEIP_04119 GNAT family N-acetyltransferase; CJLEIP_04120 MFS transporter; CJLEIP_04121 3-hydroxyisobutyrate dehydrogenase.
This locus has not been compared with MIBiG: the comparison is made by antiSMASH, which did not detect it.
